propositions: Enable four approved global Mypy flags (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) while explicitly deferring disallow_any_generics and disallow_untyped_defs.
A ratchet test must assert the four flags are enabled globally and the two deferred flags remain disabled.
All redundant-cast diagnostics must be resolved by removing unnecessary cast() calls or proving casts remain necessary under the pinned Mypy version.
All 26 warn_unused_ignores diagnostics measured against current origin/main must be removed (unused ignores have no valid disposition other than removal).
Verification commands (mypy --warn-redundant-casts, mypy --warn-unused-ignores, make typecheck, pytest suite) must all exit 0 against a fully provisioned canonical environment.
